course.title: Transport Phenomena in Materials

content.value: The inner surface at $r = a$ and outer surface at $r = b$ of a hollow cylinder are maintained at uniform temperature $T _ { 1 }$ and $T _ { 2 }$ respectively. (i) Develop an expression for the one dimensional steady state temperature distribution $T ( r )$ in the cylinder. (ii) Develop an expression for the thermal resistance of a hollow cylinder of length H.
